name: Pinterest Downloader
headline: Pinterest Downloader: Claude Code skill for Browser
short_description: Pinterest Downloader is a browser extension for users who want a cleaner way to save Pinterest content. It scans visible pins on the current page, detects downloadable media, and allows saving without external downloader sites.
author: serpdownloaders

sections.overview:
Pinterest Downloader is a browser extension developed by serpdownloaders that streamlines the process of saving content from Pinterest. The extension automatically scans visible pins on the current page and identifies downloadable media, allowing users to save content directly without relying on external downloader websites. It provides a cleaner, more integrated workflow for users who regularly collect Pinterest content.
Save Pinterest videos as MP4 files
Download images and pin media in available source quality
Export visible text for notes and inspiration tracking
Bulk-download visible pins from the current page
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`$ npx skills add https://github.com/serpdownloaders/skills --skill pinterest-downloader`
`git clone https://github.com/serpdownloaders/skills`
